notes: LOSS RUN DETAIL headers repeat on continuation pages. Policy Number and Claim Number share one column, and Policy Period is a two-line field. Date of Loss / Status is a combined field: the Date of Loss appears first, followed by CLOSED and the closed date. Claim rows use a two-line layout, with coded claim causes and accident narratives in separate fields. The coded cause under the Claimant Name / Claim Description field takes priority over Accident Description. LOSS RUN SUMMARY contains policy-level aggregate values under Net Incurred; do not use individual claim totals as Policy Total.
